text:
ada: kicking off llm-router v2.8.2 deploy. Feature flag `llmroute_quickpath` -> start 5% then ramp. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/release/llm-router-v2.8.2

deploy-bot: Automated: deploy started service=llm-router version=v2.8.2 by ada. Flag set -> 5% prod cohorts.

triage: hold 5m and watch p95 and 5xx. Gates: p95 < 250ms, 5xx < 0.4%.

sre-oncall: saw p95 jump to 420ms in the 3rd minute and 5xx increased to 0.9%. Initiating fast-disable per runbook. Disable command: `/deploybot flag disable llmroute_quickpath`

ada: executing rollback now.

deploy-bot: Action executed: `llmroute_quickpath` disabled by ada. Routing pinned to model v2.7-stable.

triage: post-rollback metrics back to baseline. Adding note to release notes: "Quickpath disabled after transient latency spike; pinned to v2.7-stable. Follow-up investigation ticket created."

sre-oncall: filing incident and assigning to infra.
